QuestInfo.name: Through the Gate
QuestInfo.0: Now that the seal on the castle gate has been removed, you should be able to proceed with the infiltration. Since it's highly likely that Specters are camping near the Castle Gate, prepare for battle before you enter.
QuestInfo.2: After much waiting, you succeeded in reaching the castle interior. However, this battle is far from over...
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate all enemies at the castle battlefield.\n\n#b#e(Since this is a battlefield quest, you must forfeit the quest and restart if you fail.)#k#n
